theorems.name: Submission.tdo_graph_lintegral_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (D : Set (Rn n)) (L : ℝ≥0), MeasurableSet D → LipschitzOnWith L f D → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in q '' graphOver f D, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + (L : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ n) * ∫⁻ x' in D, g (q (graphPoint x' (f x')))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
